segments.name: Broadband Internet networks
segments.description: Provides wholesale broadband Internet networks and managed services to multifamily and student housing property owners.
segments.evidence: We offer both Managed Services and Network-as-a-Service solutions to customers.

revenueModel.text: Property owners pay Elauwit a monthly per-unit fee for bulk internet services.
revenueModel.evidence: The transaction price for the bulk internet services is determined by the monthly per unit price times the number of units stated in the contract.
